descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologie, informații și mass-media
About the role 
 We are looking for a hands-on Senior Software Engineer to design, build and maintain scalable Python-based solutions for cloud infrastructure management and automation. You will integrate third-party APIs, cloud providers (AWS and Azure) and AI/ML technologies to automate cloud operations, while mentoring engineers and setting technical standards across the team.
 What you will do 
Lead the design, development and deployment of Python-based cloud infrastructure management and automation solutions
Architect and deploy scalable infrastructure as code using Terraform and Azure DevOps
Integrate AI/ML technologies via API to automate cloud operations: reporting, orchestration, provisioning, scaling, monitoring and optimization
Build AI-driven automation pipelines together with solution architects and DevOps engineers
Develop and deploy AI models in production for predictive analytics on cloud resources, using LLMs, RAG and prompt engineering
Implement CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, deployment and monitoring
Mentor engineers, lead code reviews and promote Python, cloud and automation best practices
Make sure security and data protection measures are in place
Document development processes, code changes and best practices
 What we are looking for 
5+ years of Python development with a strong focus on cloud automation, including building Web APIs (Django or Flask)
Extensive experience with AWS (EC2, Lambda, S3) and Azure (App Service, Azure Functions), including serverless architectures
Strong Terraform / infrastructure as code skills
Experience integrating AI/ML into cloud management workflows (e.g. predictive scaling, anomaly detection)
Practical experience with LLMs, RAG and prompt engineering; familiarity with TensorFlow, PyTorch or similar
Docker and Kubernetes
Strong API design and REST experience, including third-party API integrations and guiding developers on SDK usage
Solid engineering practices: Git, testing, CI/CD (e.g. Azure DevOps)
Cloud security knowledge: IAM policies, encryption
Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Prometheus or Datadog
Strong problem-solving and communication skills, Agile experience
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience
 Working conditions 
Remote
Occasional travel may be required
